batch_node.name: tenable dimension vocabulary v0.1.0
batch_node.description: Dimension nodes for the keys the tenable plugin stamps on the types it owns (req-tenable-shared-facts-6). Dimensions are declared, never created on demand. computing_core's tap.computing.network_name and tap.computing.host are declared by computing_core, never here.

node.name: tenable.area
node.description: Which part of Tenable Security Center a node or edge describes: run (consoles, scanners, zones, repositories, scan runs and results), finding (plugin results), observation (observed hosts and programs), plugin (plugins and families) or risk (accept-risk and recast-risk rules, asset lists). Stamped by every tenable node and edge type through DEFAULT_DIMENSIONS or default_dimensions. Not part of any natural key.

node.name: tenable.instance
node.description: Which Security Center a Tenable-owned node came from: the console's instance key, its canonical root URL (scheme, lower-cased host and explicit port), stamped by the collector on every Tenable-owned node. Open-valued, one value per console. Not part of any natural key: identity uses the instance_key column, which the generated search can filter, and dimensions are ignored by it.

node.name: tenable.scan_result
node.description: The newest Tenable scan result whose individual view returned a node: the scan result id, stamped by the collector on findings, compliance results, observed hosts and observed programs. Open-valued. Not part of any natural key.
